g.text: No network, credentials, or Docker socket.
CPU / RAM / PID / disk / time limits.
Only frozen inputs + bounded job outputs.
Green: trusted state / orchestration Orange: agent runtime Red: generated-code execution
Private arrows describe logical exchange; only Caddy has public routes.
Agent and local MCP share a file namespace. Worker paths require explicit transfer.
Printing is a future additional MCP integration; current product ends at downloads.
Design proposal; services are not deployed yet. Protocol detail: acp-turn diagram.
